edit.description: the red unlistable-tree case, whose bare tmp root resolves vitest anyway, and the seam the answer it asserts is produced at

summary: the unlistable-tree case reds under `pnpm test`: the shim's `NODE_PATH` resolves vitest from any tree, so the fixture never produces the tree its title names

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: `pnpm test` — the command both declared CI lanes run — is green on this host, and the case asserting that an unlistable tree leaves coverage `unknown` rather than an empty set reaches that answer over a resolution that refuses whatever `NODE_PATH` the invoking shim exported, never over a temp root the hoisted store answers from
notes: Measured on this tip: red under `pnpm test`, green under `node <vitest.mjs> run`. Cause: pnpm's `node_modules/.bin/vitest` shim exports `NODE_PATH` holding `node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules`, the hoisted store, so `createRequire(<tmp>/package.json).resolve('vitest/package.json')` answers from a tree with no dependencies. `resolveVitest` is correct; the fixture is the defect, and `options.invoke` is the declared door. No `tests[]`: a test-only diff rebuilds at the base.
